Rahul Gandhi faces defamation complaint, political criticism

Rahul Gandhi has filed a written regret in a Bhopal court concerning a defamation complaint lodged by Shivraj Singh Chouhan's son. Simultaneously, posters questioning his whereabouts appeared in Delhi, with the BJP criticizing him. Gandhi has also been active in promoting the Congress's 'Chhatron Ki Goonj' campaign.
